notes: Prefer parameterised shell steps over opaque model calls when the transcript is shell-shaped.
Every reusable draft needs at least one required non-judge criterion with a rejecting sensitivity proof.
Emit input_bindings only when a later step consumes a named earlier output; do not invent ordering-only edges from transcript order.
Do not emit generic step lists. Each step must name the artifact, command, or tool and the condition under which it runs.
failure_modes is required: each entry is condition → observed failure → recovery, not a slogan.
Preconditions and environment assumptions are first-class. Name the tools and files the skill needs.
Vague language is refused: never 'be careful', 'handle edge cases', 'as appropriate', or 'try to'.
